injuries.name: Terrance Ferguson
injuries.headline: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) not expected to be activated next week
injuries.comment: Ferguson will remain on injured reserve. He remains week-to-week.

injuries.name: Jonah Jackson
injuries.headline: Jonah Jackson (hip/quad) limited in practice Tuesday
injuries.comment: Jackson left Sunday’s game with the injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Wednesday.

injuries.name: DeMarvion Overshown
injuries.headline: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring) expected to return in Week 7
injuries.comment: The Cowboys play the Eagles next Monday. “I’ve definitely taken this rehab, this recovery, very serious," Overshown said. "I’ve been trying to get back on the field since the week after I got out, so getting this opportunity to go this week. I’m thankful that I’m still able to get to do what I love.”

injuries.name: Poona Ford
injuries.headline: Poona Ford placed on IR
injuries.comment: Ford will miss the rest of the season for the Rams.

injuries.name: Kobie Turner
injuries.headline: Kobie Turner (groin) placed on IR
injuries.comment: Turner will officially miss at least the next four weeks. It is another injury for the Rams defensive line.

injuries.name: Christian Kirk
injuries.headline: Christian Kirk (calf) will not play Monday
injuries.comment: Kirk was listed as questionable entering Monday. He will hope to return in Week 7.

injuries.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
injuries.headline: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) placed on IR
injuries.comment: Croskey-Merritt will officially miss the next four weeks. Rachaad White and Austin Ekeler will lead the Commanders backfield.

injuries.name: Trey Amos
injuries.headline: Trey Amos (fibula) activated from IR
injuries.comment: Amos worked his way back from a broken fibula suffered last November. He should return to his starting role.

injuries.name: Jeremy McNichols
injuries.headline: Jeremy McNichols (quad) activated from IR
injuries.comment: McNichols will be good to go for Monday's game against the 49ers. He'll add depth in the Commanders backfield.

injuries.name: Jordan Mason
injuries.headline: Jordan Mason (thumb) designated to return to practice
injuries.comment: Mason will return to practice this week. He remains hopeful to return in Week 7 on Sunday.

injuries.name: Cade Mays
injuries.headline: Cade Mays (wrist) on track to return in Week 7
injuries.comment: Mays has returned to practice and he is expected to be activated later this week. The same goes for safety Brian Branch. “Barring anything negatively happening between now and the game, we plan on playing both of those guys,” Lions head coach Dan Campbell said.

injuries.name: Brian Branch
injuries.headline: Brian Branch (Achilles) on track to return in Week 7
injuries.comment: Branch has returned to practice and he is expected to be activated later this week. The same goes for center Cade Mays. “Barring anything negatively happening between now and the game, we plan on playing both of those guys,” Lions head coach Dan Campbell said.

injuries.name: Elijah Arroyo
injuries.headline: Elijah Arroyo (shoulder) to likely be placed on IR
injuries.comment: Arroyo is expected to miss an extended period of time. He'll miss at least four weeks if/when he is placed on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Monroe Freeling
injuries.headline: Monroe Freeling (knee) could return in Week 7
injuries.comment: "This is a first-round pick for us but we're gonna do what's best for the Panthers," Panthers coach Dave Canales said. Freeling will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

injuries.name: Jalen Hurts
injuries.headline: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) out for the season as additional clots are found
injuries.comment: A report by Rapoport noted Hurts played in London with no sleep, as sleep was a risk for the QB. This is obviously extremely serious news for Hurts, his family, and the team, so don’t lose sight of that, but it’s relieving to hear he should make a full recovery. As for football, it’s a big blow for an already struggling Eagles team, who will now proceed with Tanner McKee at QB. Don’t be surprised if Cole Payton also sees some run towards the end of the year if things really fly south for the Eagles.

injuries.name: Carson Steele
injuries.headline: Carson Steele (shoulder) questionable to return
injuries.comment: Steele suffered the injury in the first quarter and was taken to the locker room for further evaluation. Dameon Pierce will continue to see the bulk of the touches at running back, with Jaydon Blue serving as the primary backup if Steele cannot return.

injuries.name: Mason Graham
injuries.headline: Mason Graham (knee/ankle) not expected to play Sunday
injuries.comment: Graham struggled to reach the practice field throughout the week for head coach Todd Monken and barring anything unforeseen will leave the Cleveland defensive front shorthanded against the Ravens Sunday.

injuries.name: Roman Wilson
injuries.headline: Roman Wilson (finger) placed on IR
injuries.comment: Wilson injured his finger last week. He will miss at least the next four games.

injuries.name: Marcus Mariota
injuries.headline: Marcus Mariota (knee) ruled out Monday
injuries.comment: Mariota will miss his second straight game. Athan Kaliakmanis will continue to serve as the primary backup to Jayden Daniels.

injuries.name: A.J. Brown
injuries.headline: A.J. Brown (ankle) activated from IR
injuries.comment: Brown will make his return for the first time since Week 1. He'll be a WR2 with some risk in his first game back for fantasy managers.

injuries.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
injuries.headline: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) ruled out Monday
injuries.comment: Samuel will miss at least one game as expected. He remains week-to-week.

injuries.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
injuries.headline: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) activated off of IR, will play against Cleveland
injuries.comment: Lane has been out since fracturing his wrist in Week 1, so it will be interesting to see what his snap counts and route shares look like after the IR stint. The team praised him all offseason and focused on him during his brief playing time in Week 1, so hopefully he will be able to find himself a decent role as the WR2 of the offense.

injuries.name: DK Metcalf
injuries.headline: DK Metcalf (illness) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Metcalf had been listed as questionable with an illness. He'll be good to go with the Steelers wide receiver room depleted.

injuries.name: Mykel Williams
injuries.headline: Mykel Williams (knee) limited in practice Friday
injuries.comment: Williams will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders.

injuries.name: James Thompson Jr.
injuries.headline: James Thompson Jr. (ankle) limited in practice Friday
injuries.comment: Thompson will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders.

injuries.name: Upton Stout
injuries.headline: Upton Stout (shoulder) limited in practice Friday
injuries.comment: Stout will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders.

injuries.name: Siran Neal
injuries.headline: Siran Neal (neck) limited in practice Friday
injuries.comment: Neal will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders.

injuries.name: Colton McKivitz
injuries.headline: Colton McKivitz (illness) limited in practice Friday
injuries.comment: McKivitz will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders.

injuries.name: Ben Bartch
injuries.headline: Ben Bartch (foot) placed on IR
injuries.comment: Bartch will be sidelined for at least the next four weeks.

injuries.name: Tytus Howard
injuries.headline: Tytus Howard (knee) will play Sunday
injuries.comment: Howard missed practice earlier in the week due to a knee issue, but it's no longer an issue for him and won't prevent him from playing in Week 6. Cleveland's offensive line will be stronger with him in the lineup against Baltimore.

injuries.name: Colby Parkinson
injuries.headline: Colby Parkinson (shoulder) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Parkinson closed the week with a full practice on Friday.

injuries.name: Denzel Boston
injuries.headline: Denzel Boston (foot) good to go for Sunday
injuries.comment: The rookie will be good to go on Sunday, despite dealing with a foot injury at practice throughout the week. He has been good through the first five weeks of the season and can safely be started in most league formats at this point.

injuries.name: Tyler Higbee
injuries.headline: Tyler Higbee off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Higbee will be good to go despite not practicing on Friday.

injuries.name: Andrew Vorhees
injuries.headline: Andrew Vorhees (foot) questionable for Week 6
injuries.comment: Vorhees is uncertain to play on Sunday, as he's still dealing with a foot issue of some kind. If he's sidelined, the interior of Baltimore's offensive line will be weakened with Cam Jurgens (concussion) also out and Emery Jones Jr. (ankle) questionable for Week 6.

injuries.name: Davis Allen
injuries.headline: Davis Allen (foot) off injury report Sunday
injuries.comment: Allen remains off the fantasy radar.

injuries.name: Kam Curl
injuries.headline: Kam Curl (ankle) listed questionable Sunday
injuries.comment: Curl did not practice on Friday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.
